title: Notice regarding a possible personal information leak affecting Fugaku and RIKYU users following unauthorized access to the supercomputer Fugaku

passages.locator: §1 Timeline, §4 RIKEN’s response and §5 Future actions
passages.note: Operations and external access were suspended on 14 November 2026. RIKEN subsequently halted running and queued compute jobs and described resumption as contingent on remediation. The notice gave no restart date.
